evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/L implements Runnable, owns InputStream/byte[] audio input, delay and sound-level state, starts one background Thread per instance, decodes through AudioSystem, converts to PCM_SIGNED, opens a Clip and controls MASTER_GAIN.

Client is the only exact-v308 external owner: queued/cached sound bytes are loaded, then rs/L(InputStream, level, delay) is constructed for the in-game sound queue; rs/L also owns the live ::soundon/::soundoff volume toggle state.

Public 317/Elvarg-derived SoundPlayer sources match the distinctive class lineage: Runnable, InputStream/int/int constructor, background Thread, AudioInputStream, Clip, MASTER_GAIN, delay and volume-level state.

v308 extends the historical helper with PCM normalization, byte[] caching and live gain recalculation; the recovered name follows the identifiable SoundPlayer lineage rather than asserting byte-for-byte source equality.

candidates.note: Source-lineage recovery from the historical custom 317 SoundPlayer class, corroborated by exact-v308 Client usage and JavaSound behavior.
